title: Intervention Content
description: Schema for the content JSON payload of the Intervention business object (specialization of Record in the Journaling bounded context). The interventionType field acts as a discriminator determining which type-specific fields are valid.

medication.description: A medication-based intervention (treatment) with dose and optional withdrawal periods. When withdrawal periods are provided, the system derives Waiting Delay entries for quarantine tracking (BR-007, BR-014).
Free-text medication name or identifier. May be superseded by a medication product reference in future versions.

dose.description: Dose description (e.g. quantity, concentration, administration route). Free-text for flexibility across drug forms.

administrationRoute.description: Route of administration. Free-text (e.g. ORAL, INJECTABLE_SUBCUTANEOUS, INTRAMUSCULAR, TOPICAL).

meatWithdrawalDays.description: Number of days before meat from the animal is safe for consumption. When set, triggers creation of a Waiting Delay for meat quarantine (BR-007, BR-014).

milkWithdrawalDays.description: Number of days before milk from the animal is safe for consumption. When set, triggers creation of a Waiting Delay for milk quarantine (BR-007, BR-014).

shearing.description: Records a shearing event — wool removal from a sheep.

interventionType.description: Discriminator value for hoof trimming interventions.

castration.description: Records a castration intervention performed on a male lamb. Business rule: Castration can only be performed on male lamb before their 14th day (see business glossary).

weaning.description: Records a weaning intervention for the lamb — separation from maternal milk, transition to solid food.

weightKg.description: Lamb weight at weaning in kilograms.

dryOff.description: Records a dry-off intervention for the ewe — ending the lactation period.

reason.description: Reason for dry-off. Free-text (e.g. PREGNANCY, END_OF_LACTATION, HEALTH).

custom.description: A flock-manager-defined custom intervention type (REQ-15.002). No structured type-specific fields are enforced beyond the envelope — custom types use a generic customData bag.

interventionType.description: Must match an active custom type name defined by the flock manager. Unique across all built-in and custom types (case-insensitive). Uses UPPER_SNAKE_CASE convention.

customData.description: Arbitrary JSON object for type-specific data. No schema enforcement.
